[1] [Leave Types > GitLab Parental Leave > Eligibility, Entitlement and Planning Your Leave > Returning to Work at 50% Capacity]
Returning to work after parental leave can be challenging as you balance new family responsibilities while reintegrating into a workplace that has evolved during your absence.

To support this transition, GitLab offers team members the option to return at 50% capacity. This program is not tracked in Workday and does not require the Absence Management team’s review or approval. To utilize this benefit:

- Discuss with your manager before starting leave or a few weeks prior to returning
- Work together to determine a schedule that works for both you and your team
- The standard guideline is two to four weeks at reduced capacity, though this can be adjusted based on individual needs
- The 50% figure is flexible, and doesn’t always have to equate to working hours. Some options to consider would be:
  - Adjusting the workload so you’re slowly ramping back up to a full plate - this won’t look the same for everyone - some team members may prefer to ramp up more quickly
  - Adjust the working days/hours so instead of working 5-8hrs days it could be 4-10hrs, or you work really early in the morning/late in the evening
  - Slowly increase the number of working days each week (i.e. 2 days the first week, 3 days the second, etc.)

This transition period gives you space to adjust to your new normal without the pressure of a full workload, allowing time to resolve any unexpected childcare challenges or other family adjustments.

[2] [GitLab Ireland Ltd > We've Got You Covered > Growing Family Leaves > Maternity Leave]
GitLab provides comprehensive maternity leave support that goes beyond statutory requirements.  

Statutory Entitlement

- 26 weeks ordinary maternity leave  
- Additional 16 weeks unpaid leave available  
- Must start 2 weeks before due date  
- Minimum 4 weeks after birth

  

GitLab Support

- 100% salary for up to 16 weeks (includes state benefit top-up)  
- State Maternity Benefit: €262/week (subject to PRSI)  
- Support throughout your leave journey

  

How to Apply

1. Notify leaves@gitlab.com with start/end dates
2. Receive completed MB2 form from Absence Management
3. Apply via [gov.ie](https://www.gov.ie/en/service/apply-for-maternity-benefit/) at least 6 weeks before leave
4. Submit time off in Workday (Parental Leave category)

[3] [GitLab GK (Japan) Benefits > Health & Wellbeing Benefits > Family & Life Transition Support]
Maternity Leave & Benefits

**Overview**

Take 14 weeks of protected maternity leave with two-thirds of your base salary through government allowance.

**Eligibility**

- All pregnant GitLab GK team members
- Available regardless of employment length

**Key Features**

Leave starts 6 weeks before due date. Government provides 2/3 salary during entire leave period.

**How to Access**

1. **Plan**: Leave begins 6 weeks before delivery
2. **Apply**: Submit government allowance application
3. **Coordinate**: Work with manager and People Operations

**Important Information**

- May coordinate with [GitLab Parental Leave](/handbook/people-group/time-off-and-absence/) if eligible

Parental Leave (Child Care Leave)

**Overview**

Take up to one year of protected leave with substantial government financial support.

**Eligibility**

- Available until child's first birthday
- Fixed-term employees need one year employment
- Must commit to return to work

**Key Features**

Receive 67% salary (first 6 months), 50% thereafter. Both parents can take leave.

**How to Access**

1. **Plan**: Starts after maternity leave (mothers) or from birth (fathers)
2. **Apply**: Submit allowance application
3. **Coordinate**: Arrange role coverage

**Important Information**

- May coordinate with [GitLab Parental Leave](/handbook/people-group/time-off-and-absence/) if eligible

Additional Family Support

**Child Nursing Care Leave**: Up to 5 days (1 child) or 10 days (2+ children). Runs with GitLab PTO.
